challenge.name: The Override Blind Spot
challenge.description: Store managers are overriding order suggestions at an alarming rate because they cannot verify if the model behind them is the one they tested. #model_monica# wants a fully automated registry to ensure every deployment is traceable and reproducible. #requirements_reuben# has a red line: no model enters the registry without a manual, documented review of its evaluation metrics to ensure compliance, so he insists on keeping the process manual.

output.content: I am willing to accept that hyperparameter tuning remains missing from our current pipeline if we can secure full automation for the model registry and evaluation workflow. This trade allows us to eliminate the manual bottlenecks that currently slow down deployment cycles. By automating these steps, we gain immediate traceability and reproducibility, which directly supports our goal of reducing the override rate among store managers. The absence of automated tuning is a temporary cost I am prepared to absorb in exchange for a system where every deployment is verifiable and fast. This approach aligns our operational speed with the governance needs of the team, ensuring we move forward without compromising on auditability.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are willing to accept the absence of hyperparameter tuning in exchange for full automation of the registry and evaluation workflow, clearly defining a concession made to achieve a higher priority.
